# **BuildTickets**
BuildTickets is a Minecraft server plugin designed to help staff members manage builds by submitting and tracking build ideas, managing builder assignments, and monitoring progress efficiently.

### /bt help to get started!

**⚠️ NOTE - This project is still in BETA, report bugs OR features you want to get added in the plugin here: [GitHub](https://github.com/BaldMenStudios/BuildTickets/issues).**


## Features
### Builders
- Disable/Enable Buildmode for people on the Network.
- Let Builders choose if Minecraft physics are enabled or disabled.
- Builders can get player heads using a command.

- Create, Edit & Remove Builder Tickets.
- Request help from other Builders.
- Claim Tickets.
- Change the Ticket Priority.
- Add Notes to Tickets.

### Administrators
- Administrators and above can monitor the Build Team and the Tickets.
